# Signet Play

> My Signet integration for Rust games with persona sign-in, runtime attestations, play permissions and invites.

## Documentation

- [Game integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-play/blob/main/README.md): Source installation and application responsibilities.
- [Privacy boundaries](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-play/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): Local data and published events.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-play): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
